domain: Convex hull of unchanged parent atomic centers, shared by both ball-union integrals
comparison: Use identical Cartesian points and direct parent-hull membership for both atom unions. Child must be an exact unchanged-radii coordinate subset. Each freed-space indicator is0or1; apply its own Hoeffding confidence bound, not an independence formula for the two estimates.
acceptance: Reference half-width <=2.5% of common carrier volume; nonnegative pointwise freed-space indicators. No claim that a natural child hull is the same domain, or that either empty set is globally reachable.
